scope: Full source, Markdown, AST/compile and selected closed saved JSON only. No collector invocation or candidate module import.
checks: Only pathlib/hashlib/argparse/json imports; AST compile passes.
Outputs require a new external directory; source terminal files are read rather than executed.
Root-relative stage paths and docs-relative image/evidence links remain portable after publication to docs.
Whole path requires production result success, launcher/receipt pass and matching protocol/result hashes plus all four path/task/peak/unload flags.
Fresh reference qualification is gated by the same full production result, all N state SHA sequence, actual 2N HP starts/completions and reference lifecycle/launch pass.
Failed prefixes cannot acquire whole-path or reference qualification; old reference proof is never substituted.
Partial preview binds the actual case result SHA and accepted state SHA sequence, carries zero additional mechanics calls, and rejects reference availability on a failed path.
Original qualification flags are preserved separately from the narrow fresh-reference qualification.
Markdown distinguishes lower on-body Fy, opposite holding, two-sided 2|Fy| magnitude sum, and mirror resultant (2Fx,0).
Medium min J and finite edge distances are saved observations, not hard-contact pressure or free-body clamp proof.
Different peaks/last inputs are not used for causal force ratios; old 1.8 versus new 1.2 is not treated as matched peak evidence.
HF independent mechanics and existing LF/N4 optimization are distinguished; HF project completion remains false.
Validation template intentionally remains a pre-execution author snapshot; generated document must use actual validation terminal records.
Reported tests do not substitute for actual full workpiece production or all-state independent reference.
Closed side18 preview actually has 26 geometry/26 nodal observations, zero new mechanics and nine new accepted states; no reference availability.
Both Markdown failure table rows match the actually read closed preview last states.
No fabricated predictor displacement or extrapolated failure/unload frames are claimed.
Remaining circular/free-body/friction/pressure/convergence/research-layer integration work is explicit.
Validation display status can only be pass when the full actual gate is true; prior misleading fallback is resolved.
Fit input is tied to current new result SHA; actual launch/protocol and zero-call gates plus every input/output SHA are checked.
Physical peak selects maximum actual accepted loading displacement, separately from return-to-zero and without claiming maximum force.
Matched comparison selects unique exact loading .5 mm only; empty/pending input has no row, duplicates assert, unloading/interpolation never substitutes.
Selected force components and two-sided magnitude are copied from stored body fields; gap/J/Green values attach by actual index and matching state SHA/d/leg.
Closed 17-state old baseline and nine-state failed side18 select actual peak indices 11/8 and both have a unique loading .5 state.
README now accepts an explicit repository root from arbitrary working directories.

findings.detail: Only the complete passed gate displays pass; a pass launch with incomplete qualification displays not_qualified.

Fit now requires current whole-path/reference qualification, exact current result SHA, actual pass launch/exit0/once/unchanged bindings/no stop/protocol SHA, zero additional calls, and all actual input/output file SHA pins.

limitations: No running production outputs read. No collector behavior tested by importing or invoking it. Actual current 15-test pass is root-reported and remains a runtime gate.
